Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner was on bail vide order dated 21.10.2022 passed by this Court in BLAPL No.2754 of 2022.

He further submits that the Petitioner did not attend the court on the date fixed due to communication gap between the conducting Advocate and the petitioner for which N.B.W. was issued on 29.01.2025 against him.
Learned counsel for the Petitioner further submits that non-appearance of the Petitioner in Court on the said date was neither intentional nor deliberate.
Moreover, the Petitioner is a permanent resident of village-Potrel, P.S.- Orkel, District- Malkangiri.
Hence, there is no reasonable chance of his abscondance from the process of justice.
There is also no allegation on behalf of the prosecution that the Petitioner shall tamper the prosecution evidence, if he is released on bail.

Hence, there is no reasonable chance of his abscondance from the process of justice.
There is also no allegation on behalf of the prosecution that the Petitioner shall tamper the prosecution evidence, if he is released on bail.
6. Considering the submission made on behalf of the Petitioner and since the Petitioner could not remain present in court on the date fixed because of the reasons beyond his control, this Court is of the view that there is no requirement of keeping the Petitioner inside the custody any further.
Accordingly, this Court directs that the Petitioner be released on bail by the Court in seisin over the matter on some stringent terms and conditions with further conditions that:
i. the petitioner shall appear before the local Police Station in every fortnight on Monday between 10 A.M. to 1.00 P.M. till conclusion of the trial; iii. the Petitioner shall not indulge himself in any criminal activities in future;
iv. the Petitioner shall not tamper the evidence of the prosecution evidence in any manner;
v. the petitioner, after the onset of monsoon (during June, 2025 to August, 2025),
shall plant 100 saplings of local variety like mango, neem, tamarind etc. around his village over the Government land/community land/private land, if it is in the possession of the Petitioner or his family members;
Violation of any of the above conditions shall entail cancellation of the bail.
7. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
